title: Unify console AI chat surfaces — one conversation, docked (ADR-0057)
body:
Implements **objectui ADR-0057** — *Console AI chat is one system, docked (retire the FAB)*.

Today the console renders AI chat through **3 parallel shells** over one backend (`ConsoleFloatingChatbot` FAB / `AiChatPage` full-page / `StudioAiCopilot` left panel), and the shells **fork the conversation** — the *same app's* build chat can exist as two disjoint threads (an empty "Build with AI" copilot next to an active full-page build conversation). This epic collapses them into **one chat system**:

> **surface = view · conversation = model · product (`ask` / `build`) = the binding axis.**

This is **not** a merge of `ask` and `build` — cloud ADR-0063 already fixed that (two products, bound by surface, no roster). This is console-layer consolidation only.

## Phases (each reversible; one ADR-0054 browser proof per phase)

- [ ] **P1 — one conversation context + one gate** (no visible change)
  - `ChatSessionProvider` owns agent resolution / conversation binding / list / streaming / pending / reconcile; all 3 shells read it
  - Key conversations on `(user, app, product)` — **drop the `studio:` scope prefix**
  - Delete `isAiEnabled` / `discovery.services.ai`; `useAiSurface` everywhere
  - ✔ same thread visible in full-page ↔ Studio copilot for one app
- [ ] **P2 — declarative surface→agent resolver (B)**
  - `resolveSurfaceAgent(surface, ctx)` + `SURFACE_DEFAULT` table; all call sites migrated
  - Fold the `ConsoleLayout` aiStudio-downgrade special case into the resolver
  - ✔ unit table for ADR-0063 (Studio→build, console/app→ask, downgrade, `app.defaultAgent` bounded to ask/build)
- [ ] **P3 — docked rail + Studio right-side reflow; retire the FAB**
  - `ChatDock`: shared panel as a collapsible/resizable **right** rail; FAB → launcher / ⌘I
  - Studio → `[left: nav] [center: canvas + properties] [right: chat]`
  - `/ai` = maximized dock, **same thread**; runtime SDUI **bubble unchanged**
  - ✔ chat location identical across console pages; expand/collapse preserves thread
  - depends on: objectstack-ai/cloud#816 (render behavior by declared capability, optional)
- [ ] **P4 — ask→build explicit handoff**
  - build-shaped request in `ask` → **"Open in Builder →"** carrying context via `assistantBus`
  - ✔ Builder opens with context; no authoring on the ask surface
  - depends on: objectstack-ai/cloud#817 (handoff context contract)

## Cloud dependencies (separate, non-blocking)
- objectstack-ai/cloud#816 — agent catalog returns `capabilities` (B+)
- objectstack-ai/cloud#817 — ask→build handoff context contract

## Open questions (see ADR-0057)
Dock side under Studio (chat vs properties on the right) · FAB hard-retire vs collapsed-affordance · handoff explicit vs seamless · `app.defaultAgent` rejection post-ADR-0063 · focus-mode deep-link.
